description.value: Prinkle Chicken is a growing Korean-style fried chicken chain originating in Vancouver, known for hand-battered chicken deep-fried and finished with house Korean sauces ranging from original to spicy yangyeom and honey. The Fraser Street location is one of several Vancouver outlets, with a menu that also includes Korean sides like tteokbokki and cheese balls. Cyclists looking for a quick, filling hot meal in South Vancouver will find a broad variety of flavour options available for takeout or delivery.
